name: Diffusers Multi-Tenant LoRA Serving
purpose: Serve many tenants' LoRA adapters from Backblaze B2 on one shared Diffusers base model, with stateless GPU workers that resolve each request through the tenant's manifest, fetch only that adapter through a short-lived presigned URL and a verified cache, and load and unload it per request.
tagline: One base model, every tenant's LoRA adapters in B2, loaded per request.

features.title: Adapter Registry
features.summary: publish, version, edit, verify and delete tenant LoRA adapters

features.title: Adapter Serving
features.summary: tenant-scoped resolution, presigned fetch, verified cache, load and unload per request

features.title: Generate and Compare
features.summary: generate per tenant and adapter, compare adapters on one seed

features.title: Runs and Reports
features.summary: jobs, worker recovery and adapters.json timing reports

features.title: Library
features.summary: adapters, outputs and reports under the app prefix

features.title: Bucket Explorer
features.summary: browse, preview, download and delete any object in the bucket

features.title: Dashboard
features.summary: tenants, adapters, workers, cache hits and timings

features.title: Settings
features.summary: theme, generate defaults and read-only server config

b2_surface.why: store adapter weights, manifests and run reports
check weight and output sizes, and the /health probe
read manifests and reports, and re-read weights to verify sha256
discover tenants and back the Library and bucket explorer
workers fetch one adapter without credentials; UI image previews
workers upload generated images without credentials
delete an adapter or version inside its own prefix, and explorer deletes

stack.web: Next.js 16, React 19, Tailwind v4, shadcn/ui, TanStack Query, Recharts
stack.api: FastAPI, Python 3.12+, boto3, Pydantic v2, huggingface_hub, SQLite; workers: PyTorch, Diffusers, PEFT, httpx

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY_ID
env_vars.note: B2 application key ID (**keyID** in the B2 console); dispatcher only

env_vars.name: B2_APPLICATION_KEY
env_vars.note: B2 application key (**applicationKey**), shown once at creation; dispatcher only

env_vars.name: B2_BUCKET_NAME
env_vars.note: bucket unique name (**Bucket Unique Name** in the B2 console)

env_vars.name: B2_REGION
env_vars.note: the region inside the bucket's **Endpoint** (`s3.<region>.backblazeb2.com`); the S3 endpoint is derived from it

env_vars.name: B2_PUBLIC_URL_BASE
env_vars.note: public object base URL, when the bucket is public

env_vars.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_API_URL
env_vars.note: separate-origin API only; Next.js inlines it at build time

env_vars.name: BASE_MODEL
env_vars.note: shared base model id; default stabilityai/stable-diffusion-xl-base-1.0

env_vars.name: BASE_MODEL_REVISION
env_vars.note: optional commit pin for the base model (worker)

env_vars.name: APP_PREFIX
env_vars.note: key prefix for adapters, outputs and reports; default lora-serving/

env_vars.name: ADAPTER_URL_TTL_SECONDS
env_vars.note: presigned adapter URL lifetime; default 300

env_vars.name: OUTPUT_URL_TTL_SECONDS
env_vars.note: presigned output upload URL lifetime; default 600

env_vars.name: JOB_LEASE_SECONDS
env_vars.note: job lease before a silent worker's job is retried; default 30

env_vars.name: JOB_HEARTBEAT_SECONDS
env_vars.note: worker heartbeat interval; default 5

env_vars.name: JOB_MAX_ATTEMPTS
env_vars.note: attempts before a job fails; default 3

env_vars.name: JOBS_DB_PATH
env_vars.note: SQLite job queue file; default services/api/.data/jobs.sqlite3

env_vars.name: WORKER_TOKEN
env_vars.note: shared token that worker routes require when set

env_vars.name: API_URL
env_vars.note: dispatcher URL the worker calls; default http://localhost:8000

env_vars.name: WORKER_ID
env_vars.note: worker name in jobs and reports; default w-<pid>

env_vars.name: ADAPTER_CACHE_DIR
env_vars.note: worker adapter cache; default services/worker/.cache/adapters

env_vars.name: ADAPTER_CACHE_MAX_BYTES
env_vars.note: worker cache LRU limit; default 4 GiB

env_vars.name: ADAPTER_CACHE_VERIFY_ON_HIT
env_vars.note: re-hash a cached adapter before load; default true

env_vars.name: TORCH_DEVICE
env_vars.note: cuda, mps or cpu; default autodetect CUDA, then MPS, then CPU

env_vars.name: HF_TOKEN
env_vars.note: only for gated or private Hugging Face adapter sources
